answer: Each claim must raise a plume from its own fresh work — one plume per epoch, grown from jobs finished inside that epoch — and plant it in the public meadow where every plume is counted. A grove of witness trees roots a plume only while its work is still green; a clone copying old jobs raises a stale plume that withers on the spot and drops the claim. Raising a plume costs 25 POA, burned on use, and plumes cannot be lent or shared, so a hundred clones must do a hundred epochs of fresh work and burn 2,500 POA.
